title: Bali Honeymoon with Candlelight Dinner
alt: Ulun Danu Beratan temple on the lake in Bedugul, Bali
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani and Bedugul
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the way to Kintamani, views across the crater lake, then Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, Ulun Danu Beratan standing on the water at Bedugul, and the sea temple of Tanah Lot for sunset on the way back.

activities.name: Goa Gajah cave temple
activities.description: The elephant cave, an eleventh century meditation site with a carved doorway and bathing pools, fifteen minutes from central Ubud.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights inland for your first days together, with the crater lake at Kintamani, the terraces at Tegalalang and lake temples to the north.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Tanjung Benoa and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel with a pool, walking distance from Kuta beach

activities.name: Water sports and Uluwatu temple
activities.description: Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at Tanjung Benoa, then the cliff top temple at Uluwatu in the late afternoon light.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you, warm oil and long pressure strokes, booked privately at a spa near your hotel.

activities.name: Kuta beach and Kuta Square
activities.description: The surf beach two streets from your hotel, with boards for hire, plus the shops and cafes of Kuta Square for a slow afternoon.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with water sports at Tanjung Benoa, Uluwatu temple at sunset, a spa afternoon and a candlelight dinner by the sea.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
First evening free among the rice fields
Optional: Goa Gajah cave temple or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast, then north to the Handara gate for photographs
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Evening back in Ubud at your own pace
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to Kuta
Water sports at Tanjung Benoa: banana boat, jet ski, parasailing
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
Check in at your Kuta hotel for three nights
5: Breakfast and a full day free on the south coast
Optional: a surf lesson on Kuta beach with an instructor
Optional: Kuta Square, the art market or the night market
Optional: grilled seafood on the sand at Jimbaran
6: Breakfast, then a slow morning by the pool
A traditional Balinese massage for two at a nearby spa
Candlelight dinner for two in the evening, set up privately
Optional: a quiet walk along Kuta beach afterwards
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Honeymooners always thank me for the free day in Kuta. Six days of touring with no gap is no honeymoon.
expert.tip: Ask us to set the candlelight dinner on the sand rather than at the hotel. Jimbaran bay works best at around seven, when the light has gone soft and the grills are just lit.

summary: A seven day honeymoon with return flights, three nights in Ubud for crater lakes and temple sunsets, then three on the coast with water sports at Tanjung Benoa, Uluwatu at sunset, a couples massage and a private candlelight dinner.
included: Included: return international flights; 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace tour; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; water sports with Uluwatu; Balinese massage for two; candlelight dinner.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
